When a rule is created, it is first encoded in Base64 then the resulting JSON file is digitally signed (for security) and compressed as ZIP file. SRE receives this ZIP file and validates its signature. If valid, the ZIP file is stored locally and the rule is extracted and loaded in the SRE for installation.
